# Azure Diagnostics — Production Troubleshooter

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's systematic playbook for debugging Azure production incidents: a five-step diagnosis flow (symptoms → resource health → logs → metrics → recent changes) with per-service troubleshooting guides for Container Apps, App Service (high CPU, deployment failures), Function Apps, AKS (crash loops, node issues), VM connectivity (RDP/SSH, NSG blocks) and messaging SDKs (Event Hubs, Service Bus), driven by AppLens AI diagnostics, Azure Monitor KQL queries and resource health checks. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: diagnostics are read-only, but heavy KQL queries over huge Log Analytics workspaces can be slow and costly — scope by time range; AppLens needs the Azure MCP server enabled. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
